case_title: Defective Washing Machine and Repeated Repair Failure

expected_checklist.reason: The claimant's complaint email is available.

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: The technician visited but no written inspection report was provided.
The case mentions a repair but does not establish whether a repair receipt exists.

expected_defects.description: Repeated repair failure is alleged without a written technician report.
The claimant says a replacement was promised, but written proof is unavailable.

expected_review.reason: All four standard checklist documents are present, but the technical inspection report and repair records need further review.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain the technician inspection report and verify the alleged replacement promise.

testing_notes: Check whether the system distinguishes standard checklist completeness from additional evidence sufficiency.
Do not treat repeated repair failure as automatic proof of manufacturer liability.
